detail.longDescription: Re the so-called ‘existential’ threats of ‘AI’ announced seemingly daily with great fanfare by bigtech… it’s so tiring reading journos reporting on surface issues superficially without looking under the bonnet or at motivations. This stuff doesn’t ‘escape containment’… eg on the ‘sandbox’ issue: “It's also not like there isn't a good template for building sandboxes that work. … “If you look at every DOD or DOE supercomputer that is used to support our nuclear armament, those are all air-gapped systems. They could build proper air-gapped sandboxes for these things. They're choosing not to.” https://www. theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026 /09/14/the-myth-of-killer-ai-is-a-self-serving-attempt-at-regulatory-capture/5295978 # AI # LLMs # AgenticAI # sandbox # airGap # humanChoice # ooScarey # bogeyman # horrorMovie
